title: Prabhakar Singh v. Executive Engineer, Purvanchal Electricity Distribution Corporation
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Prakash Krishna and Yogesh Chandra Gupta, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed summarily; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5.
headnote: A consumer disputing the correctness of an electricity bill must pursue the statutory objection under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court will not interfere in writ jurisdiction.
facts: Prabhakar Singh filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against the Executive Engineer, Purvanchal Electricity Distribution Corporation, and others. He challenged the correctness of an electricity bill. Counsel for both sides were heard on 28 January 2010 by a Division Bench. The Court did not examine the bill on merits and treated the dispute as one for which the Supply Code already provided a dedicated objection route.

holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner disputes the correctness of an electricity bill, the remedy is under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court will not interfere in writ jurisdiction; the petition is dismissed summarily, leaving the petitioner to invoke that remedy.

not_decided.note: Left to the Clause 6.5 objection remedy; no merits finding on the bill.
